original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اُمَّ الْاَئِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
translation: Peace on you, O the mother of the pure Imams,
Peace be on you, O the mother of the believing men
Peace be on you, O the first of the believing women
Peace be on you, O the sincere lady among the devoted ones

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا سَيِّدَةَ الْحَرَمِ وَ مَلِكَةَ الْبَطْحَاءِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the chief lady of the sacrosanct (haram) And the queen of Mecca

original language: السَّلاَم عَلَيْكِ يَا اَوَّلَ مَنْ صَدَّقَتْ ِرَسُوْلِ اللهِ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the first one to believe in the Apostle of Allah from among the women

original language: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ وَفَتْ بِالْعُبُوْدِيَّةِ حَقَّ الْوَفَاءِ وَ اَسْلَمَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَ اَنْفَقَتْ مَالَهَا لِسَيِّدِ الْاَنْبِيَآءِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the one who observed servitude as it ought to be observed, submitted herself and discharged her wealth in the service of the chief of the Prophets.

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا قَرِيْنَةَ حَبِيْبِ اِلٰهِ السَّمَآءِ الْمُزَّوَّجَةِ بِخُلاَصَةِ الْاَصْفِيَآءِ يَابْنَةَ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ الْخَلِيْلِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the companion of the beloved of the Lord of the Heaven. The spouse of the epitome of the chosen ones. O the daughter of Ibraheem, the friend (of Allah)

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْهَا جَبْرَئِيْلُ وَ بَلَّغَ اِلَيْهَا
translation: Peace be on you, O the one to whom Jibraeel used to salute and used to convey to her
the salutations from Allah, the Majestic.

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا حَافِظَةَ دِيْنِ اللهِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the protector of the religion of Allah.

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا نَاصِرَةَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the helper of the Apostle of Allah.

original language: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ تَوَلىَّ دَفْنَهَا رَسُوْلُ اللهِ
translation: Peace be on you, O the one whose burial was arranged by the Apostle of Allah
and he entrusted her to the Mercy of Allah.

original language: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكِ حَبِيْبَةُ اللهِ وَ خِيَرَةَ اُمَّتِهِ وَ اَنَّ اللهَ
translation: I bear witness that you are esteemed near Allah

original language: جَعَلَكِ فِىْ مُسْتَقَرِّ رَحْمَتِهِ فِىْ قَصْرٍ مِّنَ الْيَاقُوْتِ
translation: and the chosen one among His nation and that Allah has placed you in His Mercy

original language: وَ الْعِقْيَانِ فِىْ اَعْلٰى مَنَازِلِ الْجِنَانِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْكِ وَ رَحْمَةُ الله وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
translation: in a place built of ruby and in the highest grades of Paradise, May Allah send salutations upon you and His Mercy and Blessings .
